acceptance: every run-wide gate passes; otherwise the score is 0 and the result is a trusted gate failure

gates.overhead_item_floor: 10 x the shortest trusted prefill in the suite

metric.primary: 100 x mean over 100, 200, 300 per mille retention
metric.task: mean over rows of the mean over questions of the task metric

reference.attention: per-layer per-KV-head context masks, system and appended positions visible
reference.decode: greedy, (condition, question) pairs in chunks of min(16, 40 GiB / per-sequence KV bytes)
